item.title: Self-Hosted Container Health Monitoring & Auto-Healing: Watchtower vs Autoheal vs Kured (2026 Guide)
item.description: Containers are designed to be ephemeral — when one fails, the orchestrator replaces it. But what happens when a container is running but unhealthy? Or when a new image is published and your running containers are stuck on a vulnerable old version? Or when a Kubernetes node needs to reboot for a kernel security update?
